name: KATA Design System
note: Canonical foundation values. tools.sync_shape_tokens generates runtime shape/elevation and semantic-color regions in tokens.css; build.py renders and publishes the same JSON on /design-system/.

roles.ink-3: Muted text, hints and placeholders; see the exact light/dark semantic values below.
roles.accent: #33a6b8 (asagi, pale indigo) — the single accent: links, success-adjacent highlights, the core of the mark
roles.core: #eb471f (vermillion) — the signature: the center of the mark, and the center of active controls (switch knob, radio dot). Never a surface, never text.

font.sans: Inter, Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, system-ui, sans-serif
font.tracking: display -0.025em; headings -0.01em to -0.02em; card titles -0.01em to -0.015em; body +0.012em; small +0.01em; uppercase labels +0.08em to +0.14em; micro labels +0.14em to +0.18em; mono data +0.02em to +0.03em; CJK display +0.05em to +0.08em; CJK body +0.04em; CJK small +0.04em to +0.06em. CJK never takes negative tracking, and kana readings wrap as whole words, never mid-word.

motion.rule: Fast and small. No bounce, no overshoot. Motion explains a change; it never performs.

elevation.rule: Flat by default. Borders before shadows; use the shared scale for existing depth and overlays.

brand.usage: Seal color (the ink of a hanko stamp). Used only in the core of the KATA mark — header logo and favicon. Never in components, never as a UI accent.
